Repair tqdm.contrib.itertools.product repeat handling via operator.index before computing totals or delegating to itertools.product. Preserve Python arbitrary-precision exponent totals for numpy integer repeats and custom __index__ objects, standard zero/negative/nonintegral behavior, yielded combinations and explicit total precedence. Do not preconsume unknown-length inputs to infer total; total remains None where lengths are unavailable. Test actual product generation and wrapper-observed totals without enumerating astronomically large products. Preserve other combinator wrappers.

Repair tqdm.cli.posix_pipe to combine retained tail with each bounded read before delimiter scanning. Handle delimiters split at every byte position, multiple/consecutive delimiters, delimiter-at-EOF, incomplete delimiter suffix and undelimited final record. Forward every original byte exactly once, preserve byte-count mode for delim=b"", record-count mode and full-record callback mode used by numeric --update. Do not decode or execute input records in the generic pipe helper.

Repair CallbackIOWrapper write reporting: call the actual stream first, use a valid integer-index result as successful count, including zero and short writes, then invoke callback exactly once and return the unchanged original result. Binary buffer capacity uses memoryview.nbytes, text capacity uses character len. Reject bool/non-index/negative/over-capacity returned counts without progress callback; None retains explicitly documented legacy len(data) fallback. A stream write error never advances progress and the wrapper never retries short writes or closes/rewinds caller streams. Preserve the existing read reporting path.
